envelope.description: Notes-only chunk stage for adherence, functional coverage and conventions

body.title: Notes-only chunk stage for adherence, functional coverage and conventions
body.summary: The 'judge' stage of adherence, functional coverage and conventions gets chunkCalls(chunk, prior, snapshot): one structured call in the repository over the chunk's rows (the s2 atoms, in today's array form), its neighbour lines and the context atoms the chunk needs, with today's framing. The answer schema is notes only, [{ key, atomIds, note }], with NO findings field: the note records how the chunk's code realises, partly realises or departs from the obligation (for conventions, idiom examples and candidate deviations seen in the module). validate(answer, call) rejects an unknown note key and an atomId outside call.carries.atomIds; withCorrection re-issues with the reasons; gather.notesFrom reads the keyed notes. The single path keeps today's prompt and schema.
acceptanceChecks: The adherence, functional-coverage and conventions chunk schemas have no findings field, so no chunk answer can record an absence finding, an obligation verdict or a conventions verdict.

A chunk answer with an unknown key or an atom outside its call's carries is rejected and re-issued once with a correction note, then fails the review. The reasons have a fixed size (a made-up value is located by count and position, never quoted back); when a call already fills the limit and leaves no room for the correction, it is re-issued as planned with the omission logged, as s1's approved LLD rules (src/workflow/review-pipeline/job.ts), and a second invalid answer still fails the review.
Every chunk call measures within the limit with its rows, neighbour lines and context atoms.
Under the limit s1's single path sends today's prompt and schema unchanged.
